install.notes: README.md:23-58 installs Isaac Sim 5.1.0 and Isaac Lab v2.3.0 into a conda environment, then this repository with uv pip install -e source/lerobot_so101_teleop and pins numpy 1.26.0. None of this was installed here: the gate and the fake backend are pure Python (fake.py) and package code never imports the clone. The upstream environment needs an NVIDIA GPU and a Python 3.11 environment (README.md:4-6, source/lerobot_so101_teleop/pyproject.toml:12).
